senses.gloss:
पैल पैल, अस्, m. a metronymic from
Pīlā; N. of a teacher (a sage and promulgator of
the Ṛg-veda).
—पैल-गर्ग, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—पैल-गर्भ, अस्, m. ‘offspring of Paila,’ N. of
a man.
पैलेय, अस्, m. a metronymic from Pīlā.

पैलव पैलव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पीलु), made of
the wood of the Pīlu tree (as the staff borne by a
Vaiśya, Manu II. 45).
